G1_hero.lead: Bio-Rad software covers quality control, immunohematology data management and remote instrument monitoring. This page covers five products: UnityWeb, Unity Real Time and Unity Next Peer QC for quality control data, IH-Com for immunohematology and BRiCare for remote monitoring of diagnostic instruments.

UnityWeb is a Bio-Rad web application for managing quality control data in a medical laboratory. It supports access to quality control data, analysis, review, storage and report generation. The application also provides tools for peer comparison within the Unity Interlaboratory Program.

keyFacts.label: analysis, review, storage and report generation
comparison within the Unity Interlaboratory Program

items.text: Unity Real Time is Bio-Rad software for working with internal quality control data and peer comparison. It supports statistical process control, trend analysis and peer reports; data can arrive manually or through Bio-Rad connectivity solutions. It is aimed at laboratories that need advanced tools for daily control and process analysis.

items.text: Unity Next Peer QC is a Bio-Rad web tool for comparing quality control results with peer groups and viewing reports. Users submit quality control data and receive comparison reports. According to Bio-Rad, peer reports are available without a monthly data submission deadline.

items.text: IH-Com is Bio-Rad software for managing patient, sample, instrument and quality control data in an immunohematology laboratory. It compares a patient’s results with previous data, supports manual test entry and includes a QC module. The manufacturer designs IH-Com to connect Bio-Rad instruments with the LIS.

items.text: BRiCare is a Bio-Rad application for remote monitoring of diagnostic instrument status and service support. It sends system diagnostic data to authorized Bio-Rad specialists to help identify faults and prepare for maintenance. Remote sessions are initiated by authorized Bio-Rad personnel and approved by the laboratory.

T10_faq.h2: Questions and answers about Bio-Rad software

items.q: Which Bio-Rad software is shown on this page?
items.a: UnityWeb, Unity Real Time and Unity Next Peer QC for quality control data, IH-Com for the immunohematology laboratory and BRiCare for remote instrument monitoring.

items.q: How does UnityWeb differ from Unity Next Peer QC?
items.a: UnityWeb supports access to quality control data, analysis, storage and reports, as well as peer comparison. Unity Next Peer QC is designed for comparing quality control data with peer groups: according to Bio-Rad, peer reports are available without a monthly data submission deadline.
IH-Com manages patient, sample, instrument and quality control data in an immunohematology laboratory and is designed to connect Bio-Rad instruments with the LIS.
The manufacturer states that BRiCare periodically sends encrypted equipment status data and that patient data is not collected.
